data.name: Noofal
data.gender_notes: Noofal is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Noofal is an Arabic name for a precious pearl, derived from the word nafa'il which means 'precious'. The name Noofal carries the meaning “Precious pearl” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Noofal usually hope their child will grow to embody precious pearl and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing purity and inner beauty.
data.etymology: Noofal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Precious pearl.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Noofal total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: نوفل
in_arabic.meaning: نوفل تعني الزيادة في الخير والمال والجاه
in_arabic.long_meaning: نوفل هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، ويعني الزيادة في الخير والمال والجاه. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأنعام آية ٧٤ 'وَهَـذَا ذِكْرٌ مُبِينٌ وَإِن كُنتُمْ مِن قَبْلِهِ لَمِنَ الضَالِّينَ نُوَفُلٌ لِّلذِينَ أَحسَنُوا الْحُسْنَى وَزِيَادَةٌ' حيث يلمح إلى زيادة الخير والثواب للذين أحسنوا العمل.

in_urdu.name: نوفل
in_urdu.meaning: نوفل کا مطلب ہے خوبی میں اضافہ، مال و جاہ میں وفرت
in_urdu.long_meaning: نوفل ایک عربی मूल کا مذکر نام ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوبی میں اضافہ، مال و جاہ میں وفرت۔ اس نام کی اہمیت اس لیے بھی ہے کیونکہ یہ قرآن مجید میں مذکور ہے، جہاں یہ زيادة الخیر کے معنی میں استعمال ہوا ہے۔ نوفل نام کے حامل کی شخصیت کو خوش گفتاری، بلند مرتبے اور اچھائی میں اضافے کے خصائص سے منسوب کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नोफल
in_hindi.meaning: नोफल का अर्थ है अच्छाई में वृद्धि, संपदा और प्रतिष्ठा में प्रचुरता
in_hindi.long_meaning: नोफल एक अरबी मूल का पुल्लिंग नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है अच्छाई में वृद्धि, संपदा और प्रतिष्ठा में प्रचुरता। इस नाम का उल्लेख कुरआन में भी मिलता है, जहां यह अच्छे कार्यों में वृद्धि के संदर्भ में प्रयोग किया गया है। नोफल नाम वाले व्यक्ति की विशेषताओं में मधुर वाणी, उच्च पद और अच्छे गुणों में वृद्धि शामिल होती है।

in_pashto.name: نوفل
in_pashto.meaning: نوفل د ښه والى په معنا دی، د مال او جاه په کثرت
in_pashto.long_meaning: نوفل د عربي اصل مذکر نوم دی، چې معنی یې د ښه والى په معنا دی، د مال او جاه په کثرت. دا نوم د قرآن کریم په شان د خوبو په سورة کې راغلی، چیرته چې دا د نیکو کارونو د زیاتوالي په مانا استعمال شوی. د نوفل نوم لرونکی ته د ښو خبرو، لوړ مقام او نیکۍ د زیاتوالي ځانګړتیاوې نسبت ورکول کیږي.

in_english.name: Noofal
in_english.meaning: Noofal means abundance of goodness, wealth, and prestige
in_english.long_meaning: Noofal is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning abundance of goodness, wealth, and prestige. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'n-w-f-l', it connotes an increase in good deeds and rewards. The name is mentioned in the Quran, emphasizing the augmentation of virtues and divine favors. Historically, Noofal has been used in Islamic tradition to signify a person of noble character, blessed with prosperity and elevated status. The name symbolizes spiritual growth, moral excellence, and worldly success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Noofal evokes a sense of elegance, sophistication, and wealth in the Islamic culture. In Arabia, pearls were, and still are, highly valued due to their rarity, beauty, and durability. The name Noofal carries this cultural significance as a precious and valuable gift from God.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, Noofal represents the inner beauty and value of an individual. The name serves as a reminder of the divine purpose and worth of every human being in God's eyes. By embodying the qualities of a precious pearl, Noofal reflects the pure, hidden treasures that lie within each person, waiting to be discovered through personal growth and spiritual development.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Noofal in Arabic means "Restless" or "Anxious". Spiritually, it reminds us to stay alert and attentive in our faith, as anxiety can sometimes be a productive force towards seeking knowledge and closeness to Allah (swt).

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Noofal is mentioned in the book 'Kitab al-Aghani' The name Noofal carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Noofal is associated with a woman who was known for her beauty and kindness.

trends: increasing popularity in the Middle East
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Noofal remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
